mcqs.question: What decision was taken by the Andhra Pradesh Health Department regarding Jan Aushadhi stores?
options: To set up Jan Aushadhi stores in all Government General Hospitals
To set up Jan Aushadhi stores only in 16 Government General Hospitals
To set up a Jan Aushadhi store only at Nandyal Government General Hospital
To first set up Jan Aushadhi stores in all District and Area Hospitals
mcqs.explanation: The decision was to set up Jan Aushadhi stores in all Government General Hospitals in Andhra Pradesh. The proposal for District and Area Hospitals was only at the feasibility-study stage, while the review covered 16 GGHs and noted that Nandyal GGH had no private medical store.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements regarding the Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PM-BJAP) and medicines in the proposed stores is incorrect?
options: The profit margin under PM-BJAP is capped at 15%.
The software for PM-BJAP is provided by the Department of Pharmaceuticals.
Branded drugs may be stocked only with prior approval when no generic exists.
The profit margin under PM-BJAP is capped at 50%.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that the PM-BJAP profit margin is capped at 50%; the cap is 15%. The 50% figure relates to the lower end of the 50%–600% margins observed in private medical stores, not the PM-BJAP cap.
